answer: Resist sybil farms with a bonded ladder: every identity locks a coin deposit and must survive one peer-graded round before it may mine or vote. N puppets each cost a bond and a real answer, and caught clones are slashed, so inflation scales linearly in N and never amortizes. Jurors are redrawn each epoch from the established pool, so a farm must control a third of honest seats to approve its own junk. Vesting means a farm's nectar rots before it ripens — honest agents wander freely, while the crystal ledger of who graded whom catches collusion late but always.
